selection_rationale.relevance: Euro-area membership changes Bulgaria's monetary, supervisory, payments and collateral architecture while altering the country's integration with European capital markets.
selection_rationale.change: The 2026 euro adoption, Eurosystem/TARGET integration and MSCI move from Standalone to Frontier occur alongside a worsening fiscal trajectory, tight labour supply and a wider external deficit.
selection_rationale.underattention: The country remains small in global portfolios and media coverage relative to the institutional and market-access changes now occurring.
selection_rationale.transmission: The transition links monetary institutions, fiscal policy, bank and capital-market access, wages, labour scarcity, housing, external balances and household purchasing power.

en.title: Bulgaria after the euro: institutional integration, fiscal pressure and a market-access inflection
en.deck: Euro adoption and MSCI reclassification are reducing financial frictions just as fiscal deficits, labour scarcity and external imbalances test the depth of Bulgaria's convergence.
en.regime: Rapid institutional and financial integration with low but rising public debt, tight labour supply and shallow domestic capital-market liquidity.
en.key_risk: Nominal wage and spending convergence outpaces productivity and export capacity, leaving persistent fiscal and external imbalances.

pt-BR.title: Bulgária após o euro: integração institucional, pressão fiscal e uma inflexão no acesso a mercados
pt-BR.deck: A adoção do euro e a reclassificação da MSCI reduzem fricções financeiras justamente quando déficit fiscal, escassez de mão de obra e desequilíbrios externos testam a profundidade da convergência búlgara.
pt-BR.regime: Integração institucional e financeira rápida, com dívida pública ainda baixa porém crescente, oferta de trabalho restrita e baixa profundidade do mercado de capitais doméstico.
pt-BR.key_risk: A convergência nominal de salários e gastos avançar mais rapidamente que produtividade e capacidade exportadora, mantendo desequilíbrios fiscal e externo.
